Test a robust weighted combination on the full pool using inverse_error weights to see if leveraging all models improves over mean.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust DBA combination may improve over weighted.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models while keeping robustness.

The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust weighted scheme that down‑weights high‑error models but still adapts to window variance could help, so try softmax_neg_error on the full pool.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust median over the full pool may offer stability.

The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a robust weighted scheme on a smaller, diverse pool may improve robustness. I will test a weighted combination using softmax‑negative‑error on pool4, which excludes the very top models and may reduce over‑weighting of a single strong model.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend; a Caruana forward‑selection weight may capture complementary models without relying on a single error metric.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking, so a robust trimmed mean over a smaller, more diverse pool may improve robustness.

The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings, so a robust weighted combo may still win; test a different weight handle (w7) on the full pool to see if another weighting outperforms the current leader.

Test a weighted combination on the full pool using the previously computed inverse_error weights handle w1, which may offer a different weighting scheme than the default inverse_error on the full pool.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9859. Series context: trend strength 0.8356 and seasonal strength 0.1333; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.29); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.855.
